name: Product Variation Gallery For WooCommerce
author: 3wartge

sections.description:
Supercharge Your WooCommerce Variable Products with the Ultimate Image Gallery Plugin!

This plugin replaces WooCommerce’s default variation image handling and lets you add multiple gallery images per variation — giving your customers a more engaging and visual shopping experience.

Key Features

  • Add individual image galleries to each product variation
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce and most themes
  • Lightweight, optimized, and fast-loading
  • Intuitive admin panel for quick setup and customization

Looking to customize even further or expand gallery capabilities?

A Pro version with advanced customization options and extended gallery functionality is available here: https://variation-gallery.3wart.ge

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external services.

Upgrade for More

Want additional functionality, more customization options, and priority support?

Check out the Pro version of Product Variation Gallery at https://variation-gallery.3wart.ge — unlock advanced gallery designs, unlimited media options, enhanced variation selectors, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
sections.faq:
Which themes is the plugin compatible with?

The plugin is compatible with most popular themes and also with themes that use the default WooCommerce image gallery.

Can I add separate galleries to each variation?

Yes! This plugin enables individual galleries for every product variation, allowing customers to see exactly what they’re getting.
